name: Make Way Grid
description: Dense grid of image tiles where clicking a tile scales it up while neighboring tiles are pushed away to make room. Includes an intro paragraph, a title and a view more link.
contents: Intro paragraph and small title above the grid
Grid of image tiles built by cycling an image list
View more text button below the grid
behavior: Clicking a tile scales it up and pushes other tiles away by distance, clicking again restores the grid
Optional skew and random rotation on neighbors
Grid fades in after images and GSAP have loaded
